journey.title: The CEO uploads policy and style guide
journey.text: The policy provides cited source material. The style guide supplies the organisation’s visual identity for the learning sites.

journey.title: AI asks about the organisation
journey.text: The CEO defines the audience, duration, seniority and experience level. These answers become the course brief.

journey.title: One policy, distinct branded academies
journey.text: Management, HR and Sales each get their own course design and domain, shaped by the same policy and the organisation’s style guide.

journey.title: Learners finish and certify
journey.text: Interactive lessons lead to an exam. Passing it generates a PDF certificate.

journey.title: The policy owner tracks completion
journey.text: See who has completed the required training and who still needs to take it.

journey.title: One year later: policy v2 changes
journey.text: In a source-linked course, ulams finds affected lessons and questions and prepares cited edits for the owner to review and approve.

journey.title: People renew their knowledge
journey.text: Prepare updates for every affected team course. After approval, notify learners, expire old certificates, assign an update or new course and exam, then issue new PDFs.

props.title: Six academies, one platform
props.intro: Each demo is a separate tenant with its own theme, course and data, running on the same ulams install. Open it as a learner or step into its admin.
props.note: Demos reset every hour. No sign-up: you are logged in automatically.

props.title: Knowledge grows when we build it together.
props.caption: Stanisław Ulam · illustrated portrait
paragraphs: In the cafés of Lwów, Stanisław Ulam and fellow mathematicians discussed problems and recorded them in a shared notebook: the Scottish Book. Questions, solutions and new ideas grew through collaboration.
Ulam later translated the collection so it could reach more people, inviting readers to contribute corrections and further developments.
props.connection: That spirit inspires ULAMS: turn your organisation’s documents into shared learning, work with people and agents, and keep improving the knowledge together. Open source, free to use and open to contribution.

source.label: The Scottish Book · Ulam’s preface, University of St Andrews

props.title: Your servers. Your data.
props.text: The MIT-licensed core runs with Docker Compose alongside the H5P service. Deploy on your VPS with Cloudflare in front, or run the container stack on Kubernetes or Render.com. VPS/Cloudflare YAML configurations and step-by-step tutorials are included. Helm chart coming soon. Paid cloud and enterprise features build on the open core.
